SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category, faq_no ASC

SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, faq_no ASC

SELECT faq_no AS faqNo, category, question, answer, sort_order AS sortOrder, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND (question LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR answer LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category, faq_no ASC
